activation_invariants: Declared arity equals participant count; participant sense IDs are unique and resolve through the governed crosswalk.
Order constraints are acyclic and roles use governed role IDs; labels and role prose are display snapshots only.
Metadata, titles, keywords, categories, and database co-occurrence are never association evidence.
Pair connectivity never creates group support.
Group support never creates internal pair associations.
Every active group passes evidence, rights, bounded-sense, scope, counterevidence, global-coherence, authority, and product-eligibility gates.
No causal, directional, chronological, hierarchical, influence, similarity, or typed claim is inferred without explicit evidence and authority.
Composition identity and association identity remain separate and have separate counts.
Render topology is realization metadata and never participates in historical association identity.

association_object_boundary.composition: A governed visual or navigational realization supported by one or more association objects.
association_object_boundary.export: A governed representation of one state and realization.
association_object_boundary.higher_order_association: A three-or-more-member evidence-bearing semantic object that does not imply its pair projections.
association_object_boundary.interaction_state: An immutable reachable product state over a composition.
association_object_boundary.workflow: A legal action path through interaction states.

candidate_universe_definition: The exact canonical union of all deterministic trigger outputs. Mathematical subsets outside that union are excluded at rule level as NO_GOVERNED_TRIGGER and are not historical negatives.

association_identity_fields: governed stable role IDs and bindings
canonical_identity.ordered_participants: Preserve governed position and role only when evidence and authority support them.
canonical_identity.revision_rule: association_id hashes stable semantic identity; association_revision_id hashes the canonical append-only revision content. Evidence, review, authority, timestamp, and version never alter association_id.
canonical_identity.unordered_participants: Sort by vocabulary_id, sense_id, role-or-empty, then participant authority; preserve no incidental source ordering.

closure_gates: every trigger output has one final disposition
every concrete exclusion has a proof and reopening condition
the rule-level no-trigger complement is independently reconstructed
every prior three-plus-node structure is reconciled
every active association has completed review and product disposition
no active evidence record is metadata-only, access-blocked, or pending human review
all isolated active vocabulary has an explicit resolution
a final recursive gap audit has zero unresolved closure-blocking gaps

research_arity_policy.rule: Discovery is trigger-bounded rather than subset-enumeration-bounded. A source-supported group outside the current product bound remains a research association and cannot be truncated or projected into pairs.
